senses.definition: the happy accident of finding something good without looking for it

serendipity.markdown:
### Noun

the happy accident of finding something good without looking for it: *a moment of pure serendipity\.*


## Origin

mid 18th century\: from Serendip\, an old name for Sri Lanka\, after a fairy tale whose heroes kept making such discoveries\.
